'''The incredible edible egg Dark Deal + bounty hunters = fun''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[The incredible edible egg]]
* '''Published:''' 18 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif|label=This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Deal egg DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Blaster Rack (V), Weather Vane (V) (Dark), Bossk (V), IG-88 (V), IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (V), Lando Calrissian (V), Desilijic Tattoo (V), Defensive Fire (V), He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V), Levitation Attack (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Spread and drain w/o the hassle of ambushes!

The published list has 64 cards.

Under Fear Is My Ally the post lists '=Shields x 6' without naming them.

== Notes ==

* Qty 64 as published: the section counts total 60 without the '=Binders x 4' line, which is listed under Fear Is My Ally with the six unnamed shields. Binders are not shields, so they are dested in the deck; drop them if the lead reads them as outside the 60.
* Human Shield x2 is marked [V] but has no original-era (V) page; dested the printed Human Shield.
* Original-era (V) cards: Blaster Rack (V) (Virtual Set 1); IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (V) (Virtual Set 3); Bossk (V), IG-88 (V), Desilijic Tattoo (V), Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Set 5); Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Weather Vane (V) (Dark), Lando Calrissian (V), He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V), Levitation Attack (V) (Virtual Set 6). IG-88's Neural Inhibitor is unmarked (printed).

== Strategy ==

I love using bounty hunters and running amok and CCT wasnt cutting it for me. I like this objective because it beefs up force drains and makes characters capable of soloing on a large scale.

IT-O and Interrogation Room with expand the empire boosts force drains even while dark deal isnt out and makes it that much worse once it is when the bounty hunters are escorting captives.

When bounty hunters dont cut it, maul plays backup slash-and-hack to thin out opponents ranks and when forfeit has been reduced to 0, Human shield assists and doesnt allow your opponent to get their captives back alive. Make sure to setup the obsidians on cloud city to beef up power that much more

Defensive fire [V], ng'ok, and Res Luk Ra'auf helps anti ambushes which is an asset in spread-and-drain scenarios.

I still need cloud city occupation and might try to switch out weather vane for im sorry, but i need them first.

Anyhoo, thats pretty much all i can think of. Leave a comment and help me out a bit, eh?
